# Reliability Checklist: Capability-aware Resolver, Materializer, Installer, and Strict Override

**Purpose**: Validate that G56R-006 requirements define reliable bounded discovery, deterministic diagnostics, preservation, rollback, ownership, compatibility, and degraded-helper behavior before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are bounded runtime discovery requirements complete enough to require one runner-owned adapter boundary that can be deterministically injected for tests? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Research §One Runner-owned Observation Adapter and One Batch Snapshot, Design Concept §Q4]
- [x] CHK002 Are bounded probe requirements complete enough to define when probes may run, how they are admitted by the manifest, and how they remain child evidence of the one batch snapshot? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Route Manifest Contract §bounded_probes, Data Model §Runtime Capability Snapshot]
- [x] CHK003 Are complete diagnostic requirements defined for both normal route resolution and strict override misses, including all 12 required agents after any individual miss? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-018-FR-020, Contract §Failure Outcomes]
- [x] CHK004 Are previous-known-good preservation requirements complete for pre-mutation failures, post-mutation write failures, successful rollback, and rollback uncertainty? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §FR-026-FR-027, Data Model §Recovery Record]
- [x] CHK005 Are rollback verification requirements complete enough to require restored prior bytes and modes, matching pre-state and final-state identities, and no verification-success claim after a failed apply? [Completeness, Spec §SC-007-SC-008, Contract §Apply failure after mutation begins]
- [x] CHK006 Are managed-file ownership requirements complete enough to require trusted provenance or exact known rendered-byte digest proof before deleting an existing helper file? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024-FR-025, Data Model §Optional Helper Decision, Design Concept §Q9]
- [x] CHK007 Are static compatibility reliability requirements complete enough to preserve the no-manifest 13-file copy/verify behavior without capability discovery, route evaluation, helper omission, or strict override validation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Static Compatibility Response, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK008 Are no-helper degradation requirements complete for absent helper, compatible helper override, incompatible helper override with validated no-helper continuation, unmanaged helper preservation, and unresolved helper failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021-FR-025, Data Model §Optional Helper Decision]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "bounded discovery" defined with clear adapter ownership, one invocation snapshot, deterministic observation evidence, and no per-agent recapture? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007-FR-009, Data Model §Runtime Capability Snapshot]
- [x] CHK010 Is "bounded probe" clear enough to prevent probes from widening candidate sets, creating a second snapshot identity, or bypassing trusted manifest admission? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Route Manifest Contract §bounded_probes, Research §One Runner-owned Observation Adapter and One Batch Snapshot]
- [x] CHK011 Is "complete diagnostics" measurable through stable canonical roster order, attempted routes, rejection reasons, selected route or null, terminal outcome, and per-agent identity fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §Route Resolution Record]
- [x] CHK012 Is "previous known-good installation" defined through no-mutation evidence before required-route failure and byte/mode restoration evidence after rollback? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-026, Spec §SC-006-SC-007]
- [x] CHK013 Is "rollback failure" defined with unrestored actions/errors, changed or uncertain `writes_state`, `restart_required=true`, bounded manual remediation, and no verification-success claim? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, Spec §SC-008, Contract §Failure Outcomes]
- [x] CHK014 Is helper ownership proof defined by explicit accepted and rejected evidence forms, including rejection of filename, location, parsed TOML equivalence, and normalized content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024-FR-025, Research §Managed Helper Removal Requires Byte or Provenance Proof]
- [x] CHK015 Is compatibility mode clearly distinguished from invalid-manifest failure so a supplied but invalid manifest does not silently degrade to static installation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001-FR-002, Route Manifest Contract §Invalid Manifest Outcomes]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 Do the spec, plan, research, data model, and contracts consistently require one runner-owned adapter and one fresh batch snapshot for every route-aware invocation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007-FR-009, Plan §Design Concept Architecture Decisions, Research §One Runner-owned Observation Adapter and One Batch Snapshot]
- [x] CHK017 Do normal mode and strict override mode consistently preserve deterministic diagnostics while differing only in preferred/fallback traversal versus exactly one override-derived tuple? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-019-FR-020, Data Model §Route Resolution Record]
- [x] CHK018 Do rollback and restart requirements consistently report `restart_required=false` for no-op, zero-write failures, and successful rollback, while requiring restart guidance when restoration is uncertain? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-026-FR-027, Contract §Failure Outcomes]
- [x] CHK019 Do helper degradation requirements consistently allow required roster success without installing a helper only when the no-helper continuation validates? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021-FR-023, Data Model §Optional Helper Decision, Design Concept §Q8]
- [x] CHK020 Do managed-helper removal requirements consistently protect user-owned same-named files across spec, research, data model, and contract language? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-024-FR-025, Research §Managed Helper Removal Requires Byte or Provenance Proof]
- [x] CHK021 Do fake-home-only acceptance requirements consistently exclude live model calls, operator-home writes, and a test-only installer input while still proving reliability behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028, Contract §Failure Outcomes, Quickstart §G56R-006 Validation]
